criteria.name: Feature and Acceptance Criteria Journey Coverage
criteria.description: Every Must-have F- has an explicit user journey (J-##); every AC- is covered in a journey step or screen state with step-by-step user interaction flow.

scale.3: 100% of Must-have features mapped to detailed user journeys covering happy paths, input errors, and system failures with explicit AC- citations.
scale.2: All features have journeys, but 1-2 AC citations are missing from journey steps.
scale.1: One or more Must-have features lack a corresponding user journey.
scale.0: No user journeys defined or features completely unmapped.

criteria.name: Five Screen States Completeness
criteria.description: Every screen explicitly specifies all 5 states: Loading (skeleton), Empty (explanation + CTA), Populated, Error (plain message + retry), and No Permission.

scale.3: All screens define all 5 states with concrete user feedback, skeleton loaders, and actionable recovery buttons.
scale.2: All screens define states, but 1 screen has brief or generic empty/error descriptions.
scale.1: Some screens omit one or more required states (e.g. missing no-permission or loading state).
scale.0: Screen states omitted or only populated state defined.

criteria.name: WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast and Keyboard Accessibility
criteria.description: Color contrast ratios measured mathematically and pass WCAG 2.2 AA (>= 4.5:1 for normal text, >= 3:1 for large text/components). Keyboard navigation and visible focus defined.

scale.3: All text and token pairs mathematically measured and pass WCAG 2.2 AA (>= 4.5:1). Keyboard tab order, visible focus rings, and shortcuts documented.
scale.2: All pairs pass contrast, but keyboard navigation details are brief.
scale.1: One or more color pairs fail WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (< 4.5:1), or contrast ratios are claimed without measurement.
scale.0: Fails contrast standards or accessibility is completely ignored.

criteria.name: Design Tokens and Component Specifications
criteria.description: Cohesive design tokens defined (colors, typography, spacing, radius, shadows) for light and dark themes; all components have defined styles, zero 'TBD'.

scale.3: Complete token system with light and dark themes, concrete hex values, typography scale, and full component interaction states (hover, focus, disabled, loading).
scale.2: Tokens defined, but minor omissions in component loading/disabled states.
scale.1: Contains placeholders ('TBD', generic tokens) or lacks dark theme tokens.
scale.0: No design tokens or component specifications.

criteria.name: Grounding and Persona Citations
criteria.description: Every screen cites a persona (P-##) from the PRD. Zero invented screens, zero foreign project domain terms, and zero ungrounded numbers.

scale.3: 100% grounded in project PRD personas and requirements. Every screen cites authorized P-## roles. Zero cross-project contamination.
scale.2: Grounded with valid personas, but 1 screen has ambiguous persona citation.
scale.1: Contains ungrounded screens, screens lacking persona citations, or foreign project terms.
scale.0: Invented personas, screens not in PRD, or heavy cross-project contamination.

criteria.name: Navigation Hierarchy and 2-Click Rule
criteria.description: Key actions reachable within 2 clicks of home screen. Top bar, sidebar, and footer/status navigation clearly structured with active states.

scale.3: Clear visual hierarchy; key workflows reachable within 2 clicks; comprehensive top bar, sidebar, and status navigation rules.
scale.2: Clear navigation, but 1 secondary action requires 3 clicks without domain justification.
scale.1: Navigation structure ambiguous or key actions buried.

criteria.name: Responsive Breakpoints and Layout Constraints
criteria.description: Layout rules defined across standard breakpoints (< 640px, 640-1024px, > 1024px) with maximum content reading widths and grid gutters.

scale.3: Detailed responsive layout rules across all three breakpoints with content max-widths and drawer/collapse behaviors.
scale.2: Breakpoints covered, but tablet view details are brief.
scale.1: Only desktop layout defined; mobile/tablet omitted.

criteria.name: Traceability to API Endpoints and Schema Tables
criteria.description: Every screen and journey maps to corresponding Architect API endpoints (API-###) and database tables (TBL-###).

scale.3: Seamless technical alignment: every screen, form, and journey step cites the exact API-### endpoints and TBL-### tables it interacts with.
scale.2: Most screens map to APIs, but 1 endpoint citation is omitted.
scale.1: Screens disconnected from technical architecture contracts.
scale.0: Zero technical traceability to APIs or database schema.
